verdict.rationale:
Supabase documents a built-in 'AI Assistant' integrated directly into the Supabase Dashboard that users can delegate tasks to — generating SQL/schema designs, debugging errors, giving context-aware table recommendations, and even deploying Edge Functions autonomously ('Deploy a new function > Via AI Assistant'). This is a first-party, in-product assistant distinct from the external MCP/agent tooling.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the dashboard AI Assistant's behavior, and more detail on its task scope/limits beyond the feature page.
